EXPERIENCE CRITERIA – The Bidder should have successfully executed works associated with Supply of AFFF work at any Centr al/ State Govt Organization / PSU/ Public Listed Company with a minimum value(s) of the directly execu ted work as indicated below in last five years reckoned from the due date of submission of bids: I. Three jobs each of value not less than Rs. 40% of the estimated bid value The copies of contracts/ work orders and documentary evidence of successful execution/completion in support of Past Experience of Similar Services along with names, addresses, and contact details of clien ts shall be uploaded with the bid for verification by the Buyer. Experience of having successfully completed similar work during the last 3 years up to the month previ ous to the one in which the tender is invited. The category for qualification of vendor in tender participa tion: - Vendor with experience certificate of similar job of Supply of AFFF carried out in any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU / Public Listed Company. If supporting document from above mentioned criteria is not there, then vendor’s participation stands cancelled in Technical Evaluation and can be rejected before opening Price Bid. 2. FINANCIAL CRITERIA – i) The minimum average annual financial turnover of the Bidder shall not be less than INR 18 lacs as p er audited annual financial results in last 3 (Three) financial years up to the due date of submission of b ids. ii) The Bidder’s Net Worth as per the latest audited financial statement shall be positive. The Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a cert ificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution/incorporation of the bidd er is less than 3- year-old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the d ate of the constitution shall be taken into account for these criteria. 3. TECHNICAL BID EVALUATION CRITERIA – 1) Vendor has to acknowledge, and upload signed copy of all the tender documents uploaded by lo cation (complete understanding of scope of work and terms-conditions of tender).

2) If any of the document is left out to upload, the vendor is liable for disqualification or rejected, fro m further price bid opening procedure. 3) Bidder has to mandatorily submit all test reports as specified in technical specification document 4) The AFFF shall be UL (Underwriters Laboratories) listed as per UL-162 & shall carry BIS certification marking. .
